capabilities: Search within the active Markdown note
Highlight all matches and emphasize the current one
Jump to next or previous match
Align the matched line to the top of the editor viewport
Drag, resize, and keep the floating search window open while editing
disambiguation: Not vault-wide search; it only searches inside the currently active Markdown note.
extras: Manual installation only; interface supports Chinese and English; the search window is not an Obsidian modal, so Esc does not close it.
problem: Obsidian lacks a browser-like in-note find bar with predictable viewport positioning when jumping between matches in long notes.
summary: Floating find bar that searches within the active note and aligns each jumped-to match's line to the top of the editor viewport.
